title: JavaScript Programming
description: A free, project-based JavaScript course for school leavers who want to build interactive websites. Over four weeks you build small real apps in the browser – a counter, a tip calculator, a to-do list, a quiz and a product catalogue – and finish with a portfolio piece you can show clients.
outcomes: Write JavaScript with variables, conditions, loops and functions
Make web pages react to clicks and form input using the DOM
Store and display data with arrays and objects
Remember data between visits with localStorage
Build a working product catalogue with search and filters
Explain your projects to a client or employer
